messages:
anna-sec: :rotating_light: CVE-2026-1420 discovered in upstream OpenSSL fork we ship in runtime images — session-ticket rekey 'bleed' leak. Active exploitation seen in the wild (public indicators).
liam-infra: Which services use that build? edge-proxy, runtime-pool images, and the internal test harness probably.
denise-eng: Can we quick-mitigate by disabling session tickets / resumption at the TLS termination layer?
anna-sec: Yes. Immediate mitigations we should do in parallel:
- disable session tickets on edge proxies + gateway LB
- emergency rebuild of runtime images with patched OpenSSL
- rotate KMS envelope keys for session encryption
- enable detailed TLS audit logging for affected hosts
liam-infra: I'll push config change to LB canaries first.
liam-infra: nginx snippet to apply on gateways:
```
ssl_session_tickets off;
ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
```
liam-infra: then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n infra` for canary zone.
clarice-ops: on it — will spin up canary in us-west-2 and watch 15m.
infra-bot: Deployment job started: edge-proxy canary (job id: deploy-1972468012). Link: https://ci.local/deploy/1972468012
ryan-oncall: For KMS: we should rotate the envelope keys used for session ticket encryption and revoke old keys. I recommend rotating in staging first, then prod. Who can run the rotation plan?
anna-sec: @ryan-oncall + @liam-infra coordinate. Steps:
1) Create new DEK in KMS (policy: limited to infra role)
2) Re-encrypt active session secrets as they are issued — fallback allowed for existing sessions but set TTL low
3) Revoke old key after 1h verification window
denise-eng: I'll open PR to bump OpenSSL in runtime images and ping CI for accelerated builds. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/8192
denise-eng: CI plan: run unit -> integ -> smoke. We should promote to canary hosts only after smoke passes.
liam-infra: Also adding network ACL rule to block outbound to known exploit C2 IPs seen in indicators (temp). Rule snippet we applied:
```
- action: deny
  src: 0.0.0.0/0
  dst: 198.51.100.0/24
  protocol: tcp
  apply_to: egress-gateway
```
clarice-ops: Blocking C2 range in WAF and perimeter. Notifying SOC to update IDS signatures.
anna-sec: Audit logging: enable TLS handshake and ticket lifecycle logs for 30d retention and send to secure-audit index. Add log marker "cve-2026-1420" for easy queries.
ryan-oncall: RBAC change: restrict who can call KMS: revoke broad infra-admin and grant kms-operator role to a small set. I'll file the IAM change and attach approval. Ticket: IAM-197246.
denise-eng: Test plan for canary:
- deploy patched runtime to 1 nodepool
- route 5% traffic through canary
- verify session tickets absent in handshake (wireshark/tcpdump) and normal traffic
- check latency and error metrics for 30m
anna-sec: Comms: Draft external advisory ready for legal review. For customers we should send targeted note to Dedicated/Private customers with recommended actions (restart proxies, rotate local keys if self-hosted). Internal notify all-product teams in #sec-updates.
liam-infra: Rolling canary is green after 22m. No regressions observed. Moving to 25%.
infra-bot: Deployment job succeeded: edge-proxy canary (job id: deploy-1972468012) — all checks passed.
clarice-ops: KMS rotation started in staging at 1972469100. Monitoring for failed decrypts.
ryan-oncall: IAM change applied in prod with two approvers. kms-operator list: liam-infra, clarice-ops. Old admin role revoked.
denise-eng: Runtime image build #1972468215 with patched OpenSSL passed smoke and integ, pushing to canary repo tag: runtime:2026.3-sslfix
anna-sec: After successful canary we will schedule full rollout and enforce ticket disabling by default in all infra templates.
clarice-ops: Opening incident postmortem ticket and setting follow-up: audit log retention, automated upgrade path, and test harness for future TLS regressions.
anna-sec: Thanks all. Keep this thread for status updates. If you see confirmed exploitation logs, paste IDS indicators here. :lock: :white_check_mark:
